Fotografiile arată încă un acoperiș de țiglă, de aceea acoperișul este redat în titan-zinc elZinc Slate, livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale.

note.en: Preliminary model interpreted from two public listing photographs; dimensions, the unseen elevations and the orientation are approximated. The photographs still show a tile roof, so the roof is shown in the elZinc Slate titanium-zinc supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records.
